detail.longDescription: Working on projects in photonics simulation in Python. Using Simphony-photonics and SiEPIC for simulation of scattering parameters of an "add-drop", the building blocks are "half-rings" that have to be assembled in "rings-couplers" first. ## declaring the circuit def ring_factory(wl=1.55, radius=10) -> sax.SDict: """ --------- ## Crea un risonatore ad anello completo con terminator. i Pin del circuito sono ('through', 'drop', 'in', 'out'). ------------ wl : ArrayLike le lunghezze a cui simulare in µm; radius : float il raggio del risonatore in µm. """ # Create rings for selecting out frequencies from the data line. # See simphony's SiPANN model library API for argument order and units. ring_factory, info = sax.circuit( netlist={ "instances": { "ring1": "half_ring", "ring2": "half_ring", }, "connections": { "ring1,port_1": "ring2,port_3", "ring2,port_1": "ring1,port_3", }, "ports": { "in": "ring1,port_2", "through": "ring1,port_4", "drop": "ring2,port_2", "add": "ring2,port_4", } }, models={ "half_ring": siepic.half_ring(wl = wl, gap=100, radius=radius, width=500, thickness=220), # partial(sipann.half_ring, wl=wl, width=500, thickness=220, radius=radius, gap=100), } ) # Return the composite model. return ring_factory(wl=wl, radius=radius) At this point we are ready to assemble the ring. ring1 = ring_factory(wl=wl, radius=5) getting this error: --------------------------------------------------------------------------- TypeError Traceback (most recent call last) Cell In[5], line 2 1 wl = np.linspace(1.5, 1.6, 1000) ----> 2 ring1 = ring_factory(wl=wl, radius=10) 4 plt.plot(wl, np.abs(ring1['in', 'through'])**2, label="through") 5 plt.plot(wl, np.abs(ring1['in', 'drop'])**2, label="drop") Cell In[3], line 16, in ring_factory(wl, radius) 2 """ 3 --------- 4 ## Crea un risonatore ad anello completo con terminator.
